proof_body:
by
  intro f c hf h0
  have hs := hf.hasStrictDerivAt
  refine ⟨hs.localInverse _ _ _ h0, hf.analyticAt_localInverse h0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hs.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv h0).localInverse_apply_image
  · exact (hs.to_localInverse h0).hasDerivAt.deriv
  · exact (hs.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv h0).eventually_left_inverse
  · exact (hs.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv h0).eventually_right_inverse
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ), AnalyticAt ℂ f c → deriv f c ≠ 0 → ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ g (f c) ∧ g (f c) = c ∧ deriv g (f c) = (deriv f c)⁻¹ ∧ (∀ᶠ z in nhds c, g (f z) = z) ∧ ∀ᶠ w in nhds (f c), f (g w) = w
